name: necro-mud
description: A multiplayer ANSI-art terminal dungeon accessible via retro CRT web interface and WebSockets — your GitHub repository is your dungeon

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.base.json && npm run typecheck -w client
